title: eos Cashmere Shave Oil – Vanilla Cashmere, Moisturizing Shave Oil with Shea Butter & Glycerin, Helps Prevents Irritation & Razor Burn, Vegan, 6 fl oz

reviews.title: Literally life changing.
reviews.body: I have suffered with PCOS since I was 13 and as an almost 28 year old woman I am convinced I’ve found the fix. I have tried hundreds, and I mean hundreds of shaving products in search of something that gets me a close to the skin shave, without the razor rash all over my face and body. I thought that having irritated red skin was the price I had to pay for living with this condition.This is long but stick with me hairy girlies, and guys! I mostly try sensitive skin products because I have incredibly sensitive skin and I break out very easily. My mother has always loved shave oils but we are from the UK (American fiancé) and most that we get here are greasy and leave an oily sheen even after washing. I’d heard great things about this brand so before I returned home I grabbed one on sale to take for her to try because it smelled incredible! When I got home and took a shower I had forgotten to unpack my toiletry bag and grab my Aveeno sensitive skin shave cream. My mother however had moved this to the bathroom already so I figured if it stung I’d quickly wash it off and shave later. The second this hit my skin I felt how soft it was and tried not to get too excited but this was the fastest I had ever shaved my face, I had no cuts, no bumps, no residue, and most importantly NO HAIR! When I say I have PCOS, I mean I shave daily because I can grow a significant beard and moustache in very little time. I have very thick and dark facial hair and it’s been the burden of a lifetime. After using this I kept running my hands over my face again and again to make sure it still felt soft. Every other oil I had tried either didn’t seem to let the razor glide and got clogged quickly, or it made my hands so slippery that it was dangerous. This didn’t feel at all like an oil, it is literally like silky butter.My biggest regret is not trying it before I left the states because I ended up paying over £20 ($24 ish) for another bottle to tithe me over until I return. I am literally going to stock up like you wouldn’t believe next time I come home. If this sounds like an ad, I promise it isn’t. I’m just someone who has spent thousands of pounds/dollars on products that have burned me, scarred me, left me with severe acne, given me infections, and left me with no confidence. This is so good that for the first time in over 15 years I put my hair up in a messy bun. I have spent those years growing my hair to thigh length as some sort of shield against people seeing my stubble and redness. For the first time in as long as I can remember, maybe forever, I feel like a woman.I’ve tried this on every inch of my body, and it is absolutely perfect. Intimate areas, underarms, legs, bum, tummy, chest, and every time it has only made me love it more. No burning, no redness, no soreness, no tears.If there is one thing you try for your skin and your wellbeing, let it be this. It is 100% worth all the hype it gets!! 🪒 🫶🏻

features: VANILLA CASHMERE FRAGRANCE: Features rich notes of whipped vanilla, soft musk, and cozy caramel for a warm, nuzzly scent
CASHMERE SMOOTH COMPLEX: eos Shave Oil is made with a moisture-rich blend of shea butter, cocoa butter, and argan butter to soften, hydrate, and cushion skin as you shave
SKINCARE-LEVEL HYDRATION: Coconut oil boosts glide, jojoba seed oil helps minimize post-shave bumps, and glycerin draws in moisture for smooth, soft skin
ENTIRE BIKINI AREA-APPROVED: An ultra-gentle shave oil for women that’s bikini area-approved, gynecologist tested, dermatologist recommended, and pH-balanced for sensitive skin
MADE TO LAYER: Pair with Body Wash, Body Lotion, and Body Mist to build a long-lasting fragrance routine
GENTLE & KIND FORMULA: Vegan, cruelty-free, and made without parabens, phthalates, gluten, or synthetic dyes
